annotations.title: Check if a health system works with Sahara

description: Checks whether a hospital or health system offers Epic MyChart that Sahara can connect to, and returns the link to connect. Sahara gives adult children caring for an aging parent a plain-language summary of the parent's MyChart record (with the parent's proxy access). The record is shown only on sahara.synodha.com, never in this chat.

health_system.description: Hospital or health system name, e.g. "Kaiser", "Mayo Clinic".
